dedupe_keys.name: lisbon temporary public space occupations licensed events and activities

description: This dataset records temporary events and licensed activities that occupy public space across the parishes (freguesias) of Lisbon, Portugal. It is attributed to the Câmara Municipal de Lisboa and was deposited on Zenodo with a publication date given as 2017/2021. Each point gives the event name, event type (for example institutional or social), the street or square, the parish, start and end dates, the date the city council issued the licence, and whether the occupation is active; examples include health screening events in São Domingos de Benfica, Marvila and Misericórdia. Coverage is the city of Lisbon for the period covered by the file. Access: one GeoJSON file of about 6 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a snapshot deposited on Zenodo, not the city's live open data service, and field names are in Portuguese. Simulation uses: temporal load on streets and squares for crowd, access and emergency planning. Related records: the Inclusive Public Space interviews and the Naples climate shelters case study.
name: Lisbon temporary public space occupations (licensed events and activities)
